background.value: White background required. For children under 6 / first-time passport applicants: 'The background of the photo must be white and the background should be cover at least 40% area of the whole photo.' Adult applicants do not upload a photo at all — biometric enrolment (photo + fingerprints) is captured in person at a DIP office or Bangladesh mission against a controlled white backdrop, per the mandatory-appointment system.

clothing_restriction.value: "Light colour dresses (such as white, sky, ash etc.) may cause photo capturing refusal engraved in system software. Applicants are cordially requested to avoid light-coloured dresses." (general guidance, not limited to children)

validity.value: For children under 6 / first-passport applicants: photo must not be older than 3 months. Adult applicants do not submit a pre-taken photo — it is captured live at biometric enrolment, so a separate 'photo validity window' does not apply the same way.

ears_visibility.value: For children under 6: "Both the ear of the child should be visible."

official_source_url.value: https://www.epassport.gov.bd/ (Department of Immigration & Passports online portal; adults must complete in-person biometric enrolment, see https://www.epassport.gov.bd/landing/faqs/4)

clothing.en: Light-coloured dresses (white, sky blue, ash/grey, etc.) are discouraged for all applicants — they may cause the photo-capture system to refuse the image.
clothing.ko: 흰색·하늘색·회색 등 밝은 색상의 의상은 착용을 피해야 한다 — 촬영 시스템 소프트웨어가 촬영을 거부할 수 있다.
clothing.ja: 白・水色・グレーなど明るい色の服の着用は避けること — 撮影システムのソフトウェアが撮影を拒否する場合がある。

ears.en: For children under 6 (first-passport applicants): both ears of the child must be visible in the photo.
ears.ko: 만 6세 미만 아동(최초 여권 신청자)의 경우, 사진에서 양쪽 귀가 모두 보여야 한다.
ears.ja: 6歳未満の子供(初回パスポート申請者)の場合、写真では両耳がはっきり見える必要がある。
